description: The api / alfredCallable container failed to start or crashed: Cloud Run system_event audit errors (Ready condition False, e.g. 'container failed to start and listen on the port'), failed startup probes and non-zero container exits.
filter:
resource.type="cloud_run_revision"
resource.labels.service_name=("api" OR "alfredcallable")
(
  (logName:"cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Fsystem_event" AND severity>=ERROR)
  OR (logName:"run.googleapis.com%2Fvarlog%2Fsystem" AND severity>=ERROR)
  OR textPayload:"failed to start and listen on the port"
  OR (textPayload:"Container called exit(" AND NOT textPayload:"Container called exit(0)")
)
